title: [review] provisioning.py:525: encrypt_seed called on IDLE se
description: provision_node() creates a session (line 514) which starts in IDLE state, then immediately calls br_session.encrypt_seed() (line 525). However, encrypt_seed() requires state == ESTABLISHED and will raise ChannelNotEstablishedError. The EDHOC handshake must complete before encrypt_seed can be called, but provision_node() doesn't wait for it.
close_reason: Fixed: provision_node() now performs EDHOC handshake before calling encrypt_seed(). Added receive_message callback parameter to orchestrate msg1/msg2/msg3 exchange. Session reaches ESTABLISHED state before encrypt_seed is invoked.
